BiographyMisc.promptExampleDefault: This is a wonderful climbing story...

promptExamples.memorable_moment: I topped out at Long Dong as the sun was setting, wrapped in orange-red light. In that moment, all the training felt worth it.
promptExamples.biggest_challenge: I once had to rest for six months because of finger tendonitis. That time taught me patience, and to cherish every day I get to climb.
promptExamples.funny_moment: My pants ripped halfway up a route once, so I just had to grit my teeth and finish it. When I got down, I found out everyone behind me had been giggling.
promptExamples.fear_management: Whenever I'm scared of falling, I take three deep breaths, remind myself the rope will catch me, and focus on the next move.
promptExamples.favorite_spot: I recommend T-UP in northern Taiwan the most. The setting is creative, the vibe is great, and it's where I fell in love with bouldering.
promptExamples.climbing_mentor: My coach always says, "Slow is fast." That line changed my impatient nature, and not just in climbing.
promptExamples.life_outside_climbing: Besides climbing, I love photography. I often bring my camera to the crag to capture the focused look on my friends' faces.
